info.title: LLMTier V0.3 Simplified Contract
info.description: OpenAI-compatible stateless model gateway candidate. Not runtime active.

post.summary: Create one model response from complete caller input using standard Responses SSE

200.description: Standard Responses SSE for the pinned Pi consumer

post.summary: Create embeddings with an embedding-capable logical model

get.summary: Token usage facts for the authenticated caller; [from,to) ordered by (recorded_at,request_id)
get.description: The first page persists an expiring snapshot of exact request_id/record_version members. Cursor is bound to principal, current authorization and the exact original filters. Revisions and inserts after page one are visible only to a new snapshot. Expired, unauthorized or mismatched cursors return 400 invalid_request. One logical record exists per server request_id; revisions replace, never add to, the earlier fact.

post.description: Explicit operator action that contacts the provider usage API; never called by automatic UI polling.

post.summary: Authorized provider/local deployment probe; may incur cost

get.description: Read-only query of bounded, sanitized operational events. Prompt, model output, reasoning content, vectors, credentials, authorization values, secrets, and raw headers are forbidden.

200.description: Stable page of sanitized operational events

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong ETag returned by the last successful resource read; required for update and delete

RequestId.description: Server-generated request correlation ID; not a session or idempotency key

ResourceETag.description: Strong resource version ETag used with If-Match

Forbidden.description: Authenticated principal lacks the required operator permission

PreconditionFailed.description: If-Match does not equal the current resource ETag

UsageStoreUnavailable.description: Usage store cannot provide a trustworthy result; an empty page is not returned

RateLimited.description: Internal protection rejected or delayed the request

ReasoningInput.description: Opaque standard reasoning item replayed by Piko; LLMTier does not interpret it as conversation state

store.description: Pinned Pi always sends false; LLMTier keeps no provider conversation state

stream.description: Pinned Pi consumption requires standard Responses SSE

service_tier.description: Accepted only when the selected logical model advertises this standard option

encoding_format.description: float returns a JSON number array; base64 returns RFC 4648 base64 of contiguous little-endian IEEE-754 float32 values

oneOf.description: RFC 4648 base64 of contiguous little-endian IEEE-754 float32 values; used only when request encoding_format is base64

embedding_space_id.description: Stable vector-space identity for embedding models; null for non-embedding models

secret_ref.description: Write-only reference; never returned as a secret value
Write-only replacement; omission keeps the existing reference and null removes it

usage_api_key_ref.description: Write-only. MiniMax may omit this to reuse Provider.secret_ref.

message.description: Server-sanitized diagnostic summary; never contains prompt, model output, reasoning content, vectors, credentials, authorization values, secrets, or raw headers
